definitions.gloss: to use up completely, to exhaust
definitions.explanation: To consume or spend something entirely so that none remains.

examples.japanese: ⟦ポイント→ポイント：11283_pointo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{使|つか}い{切|き}った。
examples.english: I used up all my points.

examples.japanese: ⟦{食材|しょくざい}→食材：04940_shokuzai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{使|つか}い{切|き}って⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{買|か}い{物|もの}→買い物：00853_kaimono⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I go shopping after using up all the ingredients.

examples.japanese: ⟦{予算|よさん}→予算：03663_yosan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{使|つか}い{切|き}らない⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{来年|らいねん}→来年：00745_rainen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{予算|よさん}→予算：03663_yosan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{減|へ}らされる→減らす：02414_herasu⟧。
examples.english: If we don't use up the budget, next year's budget will be cut.

notes:
A compound verb: ⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧ (to use) + ⟦{切|き}る→切る：02693_kiru⟧ (to finish completely). The 〜⟦{切|き}る→切る：02693_kiru⟧ suffix adds the meaning of doing something thoroughly or to completion.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: ⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧ (transitive)
- Pattern: X⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{使|つか}い{切|き}る (to use up X)

ASPECT (ている):
{使|つか}い{切|き}って⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ means "has used up" (resulting state — nothing remains).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{予算|よさん}→予算：03663_yosan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{使|つか}い{切|き}る: use up the budget
- ⟦{食材|しょくざい}→食材：04940_shokuzai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{使|つか}い{切|き}る: use up the ingredients
- ⟦{体力|たいりょく}→体力：05318_tairyoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{使|つか}い{切|き}る: exhaust one's stamina
- ⟦ポイント→ポイント：11283_pointo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{使|つか}い{切|き}る: use up points
- ⟦{使|つか}い→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦{切|き}れない→切れる：01936_kireru⟧: can't use it all up (potential negative — very common)

OTHER 〜{切|き}る COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{読|よ}み→読む：00426_yomu⟧⟦{切|き}る→切る：02693_kiru⟧: to read through completely
- ⟦{走|はし}り{切|き}る→走り切る：28375_hashirikiru⟧: to run the entire way
- ⟦{食|た}べ→食べる：00396_taberu⟧⟦{切|き}る→切る：02693_kiru⟧: to eat up everything
